help.title: Help
help.feed: The sightings list shows the newest records first. Load more adds older ones below; choose a site to see only the sightings made there.
help.record: Record a sighting in two steps: first the site, then the species, how many, the date and any notes. What you have entered is kept in this browser until you save it.
help.review: Anyone may flag a sighting as doubtful from its page, or restore it. Doubtful sightings stay in the list but are left out of every bird count.
help.tallies: The bird tallies above the list add up the verified sightings that are listed so far, in total and for each site.
